fieldissues.issue: “Strips Healthcare From 10 Million” states a projected 2034 coverage change as a completed result and omits the CBO attribution.

proposedchanges.title: CBO Projects 10 Million More Uninsured Under Trump’s 2025 Budget Law
proposedchanges.description_long: Add exact sources for the clinic closures, Title X funding, and specific eligibility claims, or narrow the long to provisions and estimates supported by the CBO report.

evidencebasis: The CBO source is retained and supports the budget estimate. The packet provides no separate URLs for the clinic-closure and Title X details.
notes: Keep the projection attributed to CBO and distinguish the one-year Planned Parenthood payment restriction from Medicaid eligibility.

The long adds the $19 billion savings estimate, Zeldin’s “cult” remark, the legal rationale, and environmental-group warnings beyond the EPA support note’s description of the proposal.

proposedchanges.title: EPA Proposes Repealing Power-Plant Greenhouse-Gas Standards and Weakening Mercury Rules
proposedchanges.description_long: Add exact sources for the savings estimate, Zeldin’s statement, legal rationale, and environmental-group forecasts, or keep the long to the announced proposals and their status.

notes: Keep predicted effects attributed as forecasts and state that the rules remained in place when the proposal was announced.

fieldissues.issue: The final sentence speculates that Trump named his son Barron in tribute to the fictional spokesman, and does not identify evidence for that motive.
Ivanka Trump appears in the tags but not in the supplied medium or long. The aliases John Barron and John Miller are fictional identities used by Trump.

proposedchanges.description_long: Remove the sentence claiming Barron Trump was named in tribute to the alias unless the source establishes that connection. Put quotation marks around Trump’s statement, “I believe on occasion I used that name.”

evidencebasis: The Washington Post support note covers the Barron and Miller personas, the 1991 Carswell call, and Trump’s 1990 testimony. It does not identify Ivanka Trump or establish the motive for naming Barron.
notes: Keep the Washington Post URL and the distinction between the fictional names and the people involved.

proposedchanges.title: Trump’s 2005 Pageant Dressing-Room Remarks and Separate Teen Contestant Allegations
proposedchanges.description_long: Add exact sources for the named contestants and quoted recollections, or keep the long to details covered by PolitiFact. Preserve the distinction between the adult-pageant recording and the teen-pageant allegations.

evidencebasis: The PolitiFact support note distinguishes Trump’s verified 2005 boast about adult pageants from allegations by former 1997 Miss Teen USA contestants. The PolitiFact URL is retained.
notes: Keep allegations attributed to the former contestants and do not imply the recorded remarks concerned minors.
